summary: Lens: add ReportDefinitionEditor for editing a shared report. It lists the placements a save reaches and offers an independent copy. Dashboard filters show their origin, drive only the preview and can be saved as a new report through the host. Parameter changes preview at once and persist only on Save changes. Conflict, failure, Cancel and leave-guard behaviour matches the composition editor. ReportCompositionEditor and the LensDashboard edit mode gain a proposal layout preview, proposalRequest (a proposal still being prepared turns stale on a manual edit; proposalHandlers.restart prepares it again), and placements(reportId) to list a shared report's placements before Edit report. An empty editor starts with Add report. New exports: ReportDefinitionEditor, ReportDefinitionEditorProps, ReportEditContext, ReportProposalRequest, ReportUsage. The editors and LensMessagesProvider take an optional locale, and the runtime catalogue now translates the report editors into ru and uz. The runtime key report.editor.empty was removed and report.definition.* keys were added.
